summary: Implementation plan for Cadence v1.3.0 addressing GitHub Issues #7, #8, #9, and #3: automatic clearing of Session Override indicators when speed returns to baseline, removal of deprecated Live Stream URL/mode special-casing in favor of unified /watch Channel Rules and Playlists, dynamic extension version display across the Toolbar Popup, Options Page, and Web Workbench, and a real-time speed-adjusted remaining duration readout in the below-video bar.
